$comment: A/B eval manifest (#318 O9). Each task is a structural question asked two ways: the GRAPH arm runs one Travsr query and reads only the answer subgraph; the FILES-ONLY arm models an agent without Travsr that must `git grep` the symbol and then read every candidate file to decide the answer. We compare answer correctness (recall/precision) and the context token cost each arm imposes on the LLM. Fixtures are reused from the O8 accuracy suite so ground truth is exact. Thresholds gate the GRAPH arm only: it must be exact (no structural hallucination) and never cost more context tokens than reading files; the headline token-reduction figure is reported, not gated, because in-repo fixtures are deliberately tiny.
